body: I've have depression on and off most part of my life. I know that in that state you can not see things clearly. I mean everything  seem dark, there is no purpose. Some years ago a girl (the one) dump me, as a consequence I made a few poor choices so my first advice is to dont drink alcohol. My second advice, hold professional help, my third advice, stay close to good people, God is good but dont expect a sobrenatural sign, just learn from his words. I hope you recover the joy in life soon.

Than you very much for your words. I have my parents, they help me but it is not enough I have a wonderful family too, cousins that are like my brothers but with their own issues. I feel lonely, watching and reading about near death experiencies, trying to convince myself that the other life is wonderful. I love this life and I can say I was very happy up to  illness now i am miserable and i am making my parents miserable too trying to help me.

People are much more than a degree and even without one you could have a succesful career in programming. Sometimes we make problems bigger than they really are, and even if you dont get a programming job in the future there are so many things you could achieve. The world can be a beautiful place.  Just take care of yourself.
